verdict: Paused search campaign is bleeding — zero recent impressions while your best ad is still delivering a 5x return on ad spend.
diagnosis: You spent $7,220 this period and earned $5,897 in tracked purchases, but only 2 leads landed and the main call campaign is paused.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads captured this period
signals.detail: Lead volume collapsed against 4,654 clicks. The gap between clicks and leads points to a landing page or offer problem.

signals.headline: Return on ad spend hit 5x
signals.detail: Every dollar spent returned about five in tracked purchases. Healthy for medical alert, but volume is far too thin to scale.

signals.headline: Call campaign paused, zero recent impressions
signals.detail: Your retargeting call campaign shows PAUSED status with no impressions in the latest day. You are leaving warm audiences untouched.

signals.headline: Google Business Profile drove 137 direction requests
signals.detail: Local intent is real — people want to find you. Only 2 call clicks converted from that traffic, though.

signals.headline: Cost per click averaged $2.08
signals.detail: In line with health and medical search norms. Efficiency is not the problem here; volume and lead capture are.

recommendations.title: Unpause the call retargeting campaign this week
recommendations.detail: It targets warm 50% video viewers and cost per lead was $6.02 when active. Consider restarting with a small daily cap to test current performance before scaling.

recommendations.title: Fix the click-to-lead gap on landing pages
recommendations.detail: 4,654 clicks produced 2 leads. Worth testing a simpler form, a phone-first call-to-action, and social proof aimed at adult children buying for parents.

recommendations.title: Test GPS wearable and fall detection ad angles
recommendations.detail: Category buyers now expect fall detection and mobile GPS as baseline. Consider creative that leads with those features rather than generic "medical alert" language.
